summary: ACCEPT. N1 provenance fix, correctly scoped. THE CRITICAL QUESTION - does origin=broker only appear where the VENUE actually spoke - is answered YES at two independent levels. Call sites: all three uses of _execution_report_from_order are gated on a non-None order dict returned by Schwab (after _wait_for_terminal_order, after _fetch_order in fetch_order_update, and after _fetch_order post-cancel), so no client abort, local refusal, timeout or synthesized state reaches the helper. The two SYNTHESIZED reports deliberately bypass it and remain unknown - the optimistic accepted after a successful POST, and the synthesized accepted when the confirming fetch returned None. Mapper: _map_order_status returns 'rejected' ONLY for the literal venue status REJECTED; executed, an empty, absent, unparseable or unrecognised status falls through to 'accepted', never rejected. So origin=broker AND event_type=rejected is producible only when Schwab's own record said REJECTED - NO false broker rejects are manufactured, which was the way this fix could have been worse than the defect. Verified end-to-end to the DB row through the real OmsStore.append_order_event: event_source=broker persisted on the status-poll path, the one producing ~95 of 96 Schwab reject events. No behaviour change beyond labelling - the only consumer that branches on origin is broker_outcome, gated on provider=='webull' and a non-empty fanout_slot_id, feeding a DashboardSnapshot payload. Three of four mutants die. ⛔ REACH, to be stated in the PR body: this fixes live:schwab_1m_v2 only. live:orb (857 unknown) and paper:polygon_30s (476 unknown) are untouched - 1333 of 1428 unknown rejects remain unclassified after this merge. No fleet-wide 'the reject census is clean' claim may ride on it. PRE-EXISTING gap, not introduced here: a mutant flipping the client-abort site at schwab.py:405 to origin='broker' SURVIVES 633 tests, because the guard only asserts both words appear somewhere in the file. Follow-up: per-site assertions - the four never-sent paths must be client, and the RuntimeError/missing-id paths must never be broker.
